newsitem.title: JORDAN: Arafat makes way for orphans in Jordanian palace.
newsitem.headline: Arafat makes way for orphans in Jordanian palace.

text.p: Palestinian leader Yasser Arafat faced spending a night in a strange bed in Amman on Saturday after King Hussein converted the guest palace where he usually stays into an orphanage, a palace official said.

King Hussein, who over the last few years has put Arafat up in the Hashemiyah Palace when he stayed overnight during frequent travels to Amman, decided last week to convert the palace into a shelter for homeless children.
Instead of the hilly, tree-lined countryside palace, west of Amman, Arafat will have to make do with smaller lodgings close to the king's Nadwa Palace.
"The orphans are starting to move into Hashemiyah, it's been made their home," a palace official said.
